children: FIGS, Inc. (

), the global leading healthcare apparel brand, together with FIGS Global Brand Ambassador Noah Wyle, today announced a three-year partnership with Undue Medical Debt to relieve at least $200 million of medical debt for those families most burdened nationwide.

Through their partnership, Noah and FIGS are each donating $1 million over the next three years to Undue Medical Debt, a national nonprofit that permanently abolishes on average $100 of qualifying medical debt for every $1 donated. This commitment is projected to relieve at least $200 million of medical debt for more than 150,000 burdened Americans, with the first round of debt relief from these donations taking place in time for the upcoming holidays.

Our nation’s mounting medical debt is devastating patients and healthcare professionals alike. While the devastation to patients is better understood – with one in three people burdened by medical debt to the tune of at least $220 billion total – its impact on healthcare professionals receives far less attention. When patients are not able to afford the life-saving medical care that healthcare professionals direct, those healthcare professionals face severe moral injury that harms both them and the entire healthcare system.

In addition to addressing this problem by relieving medical debt at scale, Noah, FIGS, and Undue Medical Debt will work over the three-year engagement to develop and disseminate practical resources to empower healthcare professionals to navigate conversations about affordability and help their patients find the support they need. This work builds on FIGS and Noah’s broader
Healthcare is Human
advocacy, focused on addressing the systemic pressures that make it harder for healthcare professionals to care for their patients.
Noah Wyle, FIGS Global Brand Ambassador

: “In my countless interactions with healthcare professionals over the decades, one thing that stays with me is how they try to do everything right for a patient while the system makes it harder than it should be. Medical debt follows people home, creates long-term devastation, and changes the whole experience of care. I’m grateful to be part of something that’s taking real pressure off families and the extraordinary people trying to help them.”
Trina Spear, CEO and Co-Founder of FIGS

: “Healthcare professionals go into this work to care for people. But too often, they’re forced to watch cost stand in the way of what their patients need. With this partnership, we can help tens of thousands of people right away and give healthcare professionals better tools for these moments – and we’ll keep listening so what we build reflects what they actually need.”
Allison Sesso, CEO and President of Undue Medical Debt

“Trust is the bedrock of the relationship between patients and clinicians like nurses, pharmacists and doctors and that trust is increasingly undermined by the burden, and even fear, of medical debt. We're honored to be working with FIGS and Noah Wyle on this important campaign to not only erase un-payable medical debts for over 150,000 families, opening the door for them to return to care, but also highlighting the moral injury faced by too many healthcare providers who bear witness to a system that too often leaves patients with the emotional and financial shock of medical debt.”

The announcement comes nearly a year after Noah wore FIGS’ first-ever Black Tie Scrubs to the Emmy Awards, using television’s biggest night to celebrate healthcare professionals. That moment was part of a relationship already rooted in advocacy: Noah first joined FIGS and healthcare professionals on Capitol Hill in June 2025 and returned to Washington in May 2026 for the
Healthcare is Human

Rally, where they called for practical solutions to the biggest challenges facing healthcare professionals. In addition to advancing policy change, Noah proposed that he and FIGS expand their focus to the reduction of medical debt – one of the most pressing issues affecting patients and healthcare professionals alike.
Noah and FIGS invite others to join them in abolishing as much as possible of our nation’s approximately $220 billion of medical debt burdening at least 100 million families.
About FIGS

FIGS is a founder-led, direct-to-consumer healthcare apparel and lifestyle brand that seeks to celebrate, empower and serve current and future generations of healthcare professionals. We create technically advanced apparel and products that feature an unmatched combination of comfort, durability, function and style. We share stories about healthcare professionals’ experiences in ways that inspire them. We build meaningful connections within the healthcare community that we created. Above all, we seek to make an impact for our community, including by advocating for them and always having their backs.
We serve healthcare professionals both in the U.S. and internationally. We also serve healthcare institutions through our TEAMS platform.
About Undue Medical Debt

Undue Medical Debt is a national 501(c)(3) nonprofit founded in 2014 by former debt collectors. To date Undue has acquired — and abolished — over $53 billion of burdensome medical debt, helping over 32 million families and addressing a major social determinant of health. Undue purchases debts for a fraction of their face value in bundled portfolios and partners with individuals, faith-based organizations, local and state governments, foundations and corporations to empower donors by converting every dollar contributed into $100 of medical debt relief on average.

Undue partners with hospitals, health systems and physician groups to acquire medical debt for abolishment. Undue rose to national prominence on an episode of HBO’s “Last Week Tonight” with John Oliver in which Undue facilitated the abolishment of $15M in medical debt. To learn more, visit: UndueMedicalDebt.org.
